contract.note: The contract counts any suit as qualifying, including LASST's suit, which seeks only an injunction. Its contradiction rule would let an injunction-only suit that ends without punitive damages count against the speaker, even though such a suit cannot award them. That stretches the reading against him. Only damages suits should qualify.
